name: Works baseline
description: Identifies the Permanent Works, Temporary Works and contractual deliverables forming the original scope.

name: Variation mechanism
description: Provides the instructed route for changing the nature, quantity or sequence of the Works.

name: Site access and possession
description: Allocates the obligation to provide access and possession needed for performance.

name: Delayed access notice and entitlement
description: Records delayed access and routes resulting time or cost entitlement through the claims procedure.

name: Notice of error in requirements
description: Requires identified errors or defects in supplied requirements to be raised through the contract machinery.

name: Time for Completion
description: States the contractual period by which the Works or a Section must achieve completion.

name: Extension of Time
description: Adjusts the completion baseline for qualifying delay events, subject to the claims procedure.

name: EOT assessment and determination
description: Assesses causation, critical delay and the adjustment to the applicable Time for Completion.

name: Delay damages
description: Provides a stipulated monetary consequence for late completion, subject to the agreed cap and rules.

name: Programme and progress updates
description: Creates a project control record for planned sequence, timing and actual progress.

name: Accepted Contract Amount / Contract Price
description: Records the original commercial price baseline, subject to the contract's valuation rules.

name: Measurement and valuation
description: Reconciles quantities and applicable rates where the price is subject to measurement.

name: Adjustments for changes in cost
description: Provides a formula-based route for specified movements in labour, goods and other inputs.

name: Interim Payment
description: Controls application, assessment, certification and timing of interim amounts due.

name: Interim payment application
description: Identifies the contractor's periodic statement and supporting records for amounts claimed as due.

name: Unforeseeable physical conditions
description: Allocates the consequences of qualifying physical conditions encountered at the Site.

name: Exceptional events / force majeure
description: Defines relief where qualifying events beyond a party's control materially affect performance.

name: Exceptional event notice and mitigation
description: Controls notice, continuing updates and reasonable steps to reduce the event's effects.

name: Care of the Works
description: Allocates responsibility for care of the Works before taking-over and specified post-taking-over work.

name: Delay Damages
description: Models delay damages as a contractual remedy arising from failure to meet the completion baseline.

name: Delay damages cap and recovery
description: Records the agreed ceiling and payment or deduction route for delay damages.

name: Defects correction
description: Requires notified defects to be corrected and provides consequences if correction is not achieved.

name: Party indemnities
description: Allocates specified responsibility for personal injury, property damage and related loss.

name: Termination by Employer
description: Defines material contractor defaults and the procedural route to employer termination.

name: Notice of Claim
description: Starts the contractual claims process and preserves the asserted entitlement, subject to timing rules.

name: Contemporary records and detailed claim
description: Supports the notified claim with records, particulars and continuing updates where required.

name: Engineer agreement or determination
description: Requires consultation and a reasoned contractual decision where agreement is not achieved.

name: Dispute board decision
description: Refers a crystallised dispute to the contract's standing or ad hoc dispute board process.

name: Engineer authority and duties
description: Defines the Engineer's administrative authority, limits and decision-making function.

name: Contractual notices
description: Sets form, delivery and addressing requirements for communications with contractual effect.

name: Notice delivery and effectiveness
description: Identifies the permitted delivery route, addressee and point at which a notice becomes effective.

name: Assignment
description: Controls transfer of contractual rights, benefits or obligations to another party.
